summary.text: Tom Burditt is a Republican state representative from Rutland-2 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2011 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Tom Burditt owns Tom Burditt's Rx Lawn Systems, was previously a partner in Vaillancourt Tree Landscape, and is a Vermont State Certified Pesticides Applicator.
He coached varsity wrestling at Rutland High School from 1997 to 2001 and was a Town of West Rutland selectman from 2005 to 2006.
Burditt assumed office in the Vermont House in 2011.
Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee for the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
